translations.web: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
translations.bsb: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
translations.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
